productionPath: GAMEPLAY → INGEST → SESSION → TRANSCRIPT? → HIGHLIGHTS → SCORE → CLIP → RENDER → CONTENT STUDIO → RIGHTS → QA → READY_FOR_REVIEW → APPROVAL → PUBLISH
rule: Before implementing any content/video/clip/highlight/publish feature: read this file. Extend the canonical owner. If unclear, BLOCK and report. No second pipeline, render engine, publisher, or highlight engine.

gameplay.ingest.name: gameplay.ingest
gameplay.ingest.notes: prepareGameplaySession lands in #1158. Watcher Instant Replay must call prepare-session, not bare ingest.

session.registry.name: session.registry
session.registry.notes: No second session table or JSON store. Envelope field incoming on #1158.

transcription.name: transcription
transcription.notes: Fail-closed sidecar only. Whisper present throws BLOCKED_WHISPER_ADAPTER. Gameplay does not require transcript; use highlight.detect. Any STT (Whisper/WhisperX) must implement TranscriptionAdapter here.

highlight.detect.name: highlight.detect
highlight.detect.notes: Gameplay = silencedetect peaks. Transcript clips use clip-discovery.ts as ADAPTER for scripted/commentary, not a second gameplay engine. Auto-clipper is REFERENCE_ONLY.

highlight.score.name: highlight.score
highlight.score.notes: Incoming #1158. Quality over quota. MIN_PRIMARY_SCORE=35, max 5. Do not invent a second scorer.

clip.extract.name: clip.extract
clip.extract.notes: lib/content-engine/src/render/ffmpeg-adapter.ts trim is ADAPTER for scene-compose only. ADR-058 defers merging argv.

vertical.reframe.name: vertical.reframe
vertical.reframe.notes: Forces libx264 + yuv420p + aac. Do not swap to content-engine scale() without an ffmpeg golden test (ADR-058).

captions.name: captions
captions.notes: Video hooks stay generic (Gameplay highlight). caption-generator.ts is event-draft copy, other domain. content-engine srt.ts is scene-compose ADAPTER.

render.name: render
deprecated_paths: apps/rendering-engine (Hermes MCP) — superseded for this pipeline
render.notes: Gameplay render = FFmpeg via renderTopClips. MoneyPrinterTurbo + ContentVideoWorker = synthetic event/kids video ADAPTER, not gameplay. Remotion = REFERENCE_ONLY until ADR + cost approval.

dragon.overlay.name: dragon.overlay
dragon.overlay.notes: DragonCyberMode defaults to NONE on #1158. Extend ffmpeg.ts when a real overlay exists. Do not add a new overlay engine or LivePortrait vendor.

rights.name: rights
rights.notes: MUSIC_RIGHTS stays UNKNOWN until proven. commentary mode always human review. compliance-checker.ts is event-draft secrets regex, other domain.

qa.name: qa
qa.notes: Advisory qaFlags only. Never auto-approve or auto-publish.

approval.name: approval
approval.notes: Moon is the human gate for gameplay. lib/content-engine approval state-machine is scene-compose ADAPTER. content-approval-queue.ts is event-draft ADAPTER. PC gamer must not store approval.

publish.name: publish
publish.notes: assertHumanApprovedPublish required. OPSLY_CONTENT_PUBLISHING=disabled by default. AUTO_PUBLISH stays off. Credentials only on VPS via Doppler. enqueueApprovedPublishJob (#1158) is a record, not an upload.

metrics.name: metrics
metrics.notes: analytics: not-wired-no-metrics-source. Do not invent views/CTR/retention. BLOCK fake dashboards.

scene_compose.use: Original stills→ffmpeg storyboards (Bitsitos/Splashitos scripted). Not Mauro gameplay.

event_drafts.use: Runtime event → caption/story → MoneyPrinterTurbo. Not gameplay.

brand_bible.use: Opsly brand Character Bible. Do not mix into icso-gaming-tbd.
